description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'voting_soft' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer feeding a soft-voting ensemble of Logistic Regression, calibrated Linear SVM, and Multinomial Naive Bayes.
model: voting_soft (TF-IDF word featurizer + soft-voting ensemble of LogisticRegression, calibrated LinearSVC, MultinomialNB)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'voting_soft', group(s): ensemble); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
